I was lucky to receive the FISP subsidy coupon this season, so I will apply both NPK and urea to my maize plot to make the most of it. I will use the improved maize seed that comes with the program because it gives better yield when fertilizer is applied. My family will do most of the work—land preparation, planting, weeding, and harvesting—but I will hire a few extra hands during peak weeding time since I have other plots to manage too. I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, and I do not have enough manure for this plot.
